propositions: A flat per-context char bound (_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS=100,000) refuses valid recovery requests (c9f7: 121,147 chars) despite the economic ceiling (context × criteria product) remaining within ratified limits, because the per-axis split is arbitrary and chases a monotonically growing tail

Recovery preflight must distinguish two independent ceilings: physical (model's own context window, not escalation max) and economic (context_chars × criteria_count, capped at 3.2M to bound per-criterion fan-out), replacing the conflated flat constant

The physical ceiling should derive from the resolved verifier model's context window via an own-window accessor (not escalation max), stored in a shared model_classes.py table moved from plan_review/sizing.py, with a conservative ladder-minimum default for unknown models

The economic ceiling (3.2M chars) is explicitly interim, modeling the per-criterion fan-out that the banked-verification sibling (ticket 2948) will replace with batched successors, shrinking the product by ~8x

Live c9f7 (context 121,147 chars × 22 criteria = 2.67M chars) must pass preflight validation under the window-derived ceiling (claude-sonnet-4-6 own window 1M tokens → 2M char limit) and complete recovery to a verdict in bounded Bedrock calls

Existing pinned invariants (no context elision, criteria budget ≤ context budget, zero billable calls on over-budget refusal) must remain green, with diagnostics showing both ceiling types in refusal errors
